info.title: Societe Generale Prime Services Indices Feed
info.description:
Public data feed for Societe Generale's systematic-strategy (CTA / managed-futures) benchmark indices, as published behind SG's Trend Indicator screen widget. Returns the full daily NAV history (from 2000-01-01, updated T+1) for the SG Trend Indicator, SG CTA Index, and SG Trend Index, alongside the S&P 500 Total Return benchmark.

The response is a CSV document (served as application/octet-stream) with the header row `trade_date,SG Trend Indicator,SG CTA Index,SG Trend Index,S&P 500 TR` and one row per trading day. No authentication is required.

Ticker mapping commonly used by clients: SG_CTA = 'SG CTA Index' (Bloomberg NEIXCTA), SG_TREND = 'SG Trend Index' (Bloomberg NEIXCTAT). This is an undocumented fileadmin asset backing SG's public chart widget, not a formally published API — treat as a research feed, not a licensed production source.

get.summary: Get the SG CTA / SG Trend index NAV history (CSV)
get.description: Returns the full daily NAV history CSV for the SG Trend Indicator, SG CTA Index (SG_CTA, Bloomberg NEIXCTA), and SG Trend Index (SG_TREND, Bloomberg NEIXCTAT), plus the S&P 500 Total Return benchmark. First column is `trade_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). Data starts 2000-01-01 and is updated T+1 (published ~2pm US Eastern). The most recent trading day may have blank index cells until that day's NAV is finalised.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional cache-buster value (any string; typically a random number). The feed returns the same data with or without it; use a fresh value to bypass any intermediate cache.

200.description: CSV document of daily index NAVs. Header: `trade_date,SG Trend Indicator,SG CTA Index,SG Trend Index,S&P 500 TR`.

schema.description: CSV text. One header row followed by one row per trading day: trade_date,SG Trend Indicator,SG CTA Index,SG Trend Index,S&P 500 TR.

301.description: Moved permanently. Returned for sibling paths (e.g. a trailing slash); the canonical resource is this exact path with no trailing slash.

404.description: Not found. Returned when the feed path is incorrect or the asset has been relocated by SG.

IndexNavRow.description: Logical shape of a single parsed CSV row (the feed itself is CSV, not JSON). Index columns may be empty on the latest, not-yet-finalised trading day.

SG CTA Index.description: SG CTA Index NAV (SG_CTA, Bloomberg NEIXCTA).

SG Trend Index.description: SG Trend Index NAV (SG_TREND, Bloomberg NEIXCTAT).
